sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: "ISRCs" columns (native `ul.isrcs` listing pages such as artist-recordings, and this script's own release-tracks synthetic column) now always display the hyphenated `CC-XXX-YY-NNNNN` form, with the country/year segments lightly tinted, regardless of whether MusicBrainz's own native markup or the third-party jesus2099 script produced the cell — `initIsrcFormatting()`, page-agnostic, self-detecting via `a[href^="/isrc/"]`.
A code that doesn't match the CC-XXX-YY-NNNNN shape now renders with a ⚠️ warning glyph and an explanatory tooltip instead of being silently reformatted or left unremarked — `data-mb-isrc-invalid`.

The same validity check now applies to native "ISWC" columns against ISO 15707's `T-NNNNNNNNN-C` format (including the computed check digit) — `initIswcValidation()`. MusicBrainz's native ISWC display is already correctly formatted, so this only ever adds the ⚠️ glyph to a malformed code, never rewrites a valid one.

The 📊 unique-values dropdown for an "ISRCs" column now offers five new sections: "ISRC - Country", "- Registrant", "- Year" (resolved to a 4-digit year), "- Designation", and "- Validity" (✅/⚠️ valid/invalid counts) — `_findCellIsrcParts()`.
The 📊 dropdown for an "ISWC" column now offers an "ISWC - Validity" section — `_findCellIswcParts()`.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: Credited jesus2099's `mb_INLINE-STUFF.user.js` (`coolifyISRC()`) in the third-party attribution block — this script's ISRC hyphenation/tinting is modelled on, not copied from or dependent on, that function.
`sa_enable_release_tracks_isrc_column`'s description now notes that column-existence gating is independent of the (unconditional) ISRC reformatting/validity behavior.
